description.short: Application security analysis via Claude AI agents
description.full: threatlint runs 14 specialized application security agents powered by Claude AI. Threat modeling, code review, secrets scanning, dependency auditing, compliance mapping, and adversarial red-team scenarios — all from Microsoft Teams.

commands.title: compliance-check
commands.description: Map findings to ASVS, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2

commands.title: attack-tree
